grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: A Busy Week at the Sunshine Café
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文是关于一个咖啡馆员工的一周工作。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。
passage:
A Busy Week at the Sunshine Café

A. Lin is a server at the Sunshine Café. She works five days a week. On Monday, she starts at 8 a.m. She must open the café and turn on the lights. She has to check the coffee machines. She can take a short break at 10 a.m.

B. On Tuesday, Lin works from 12 p.m. to 8 p.m. She has to serve lunch to many people. The café is very busy at lunchtime. She must clean tables quickly. She can eat lunch at 2 p.m. Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee. Lin cleaned it fast. The customer said, "Thank you."

C. Wednesday is Lin's day off. She does not work. She usually goes to the market. She buys food for her family. She can relax at home in the afternoon.

D. On Thursday, Lin works the evening shift. She starts at 4 p.m. She must close the café at 10 p.m. She has to count the money. She can go home at 10:30 p.m. Last Thursday, she forgot her keys. She had to wait for her friend.

E. Friday is a busy day. Lin works from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. She has to help the new worker. The new worker is Tom. He must learn to make coffee. Lin can teach him. Last Friday, Tom made a mistake. He put too much sugar in a drink. Lin helped him fix it.

F. On Saturday, Lin does not work. She often visits her parents. She can sleep late. On Sunday, she prepares for the next week. She must wash her uniform. She has to buy food for the week. She can watch TV in the evening. Lin likes her job. She says, "I have to work hard, but I can help people. That is good."

questions.prompt: What time does Lin start work on Monday?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段明确说：On Monday, she starts at 8 a.m. 所以选8 a.m.。
questions.evidence: On Monday, she starts at 8 a.m.

questions.prompt: What does Lin have to do on Monday?
options: She has to check the coffee machines.
She has to count the money.
answers: She has to check the coffee machines.
questions.explanation: 第一段说：She has to check the coffee machines. 其他选项是其他天的工作。
questions.evidence: She has to check the coffee machines.

questions.prompt: On Tuesday, what time can Lin eat lunch?
questions.explanation: 第二段说：She can eat lunch at 2 p.m. 所以选At 2 p.m.。
questions.evidence: She can eat lunch at 2 p.m.

questions.explanation: 第二段最后说：Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee. 其他选项是其他天的事。
questions.evidence: Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee.

questions.prompt: What does Lin usually do on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 第三段说：She usually goes to the market. 周三她不上班，所以不是工作；看望父母是周六的事。
questions.evidence: She usually goes to the market.

questions.prompt: On Thursday, what time must Lin close the café?
questions.explanation: 第四段说：She must close the café at 10 p.m. 所以选At 10 p.m.。
questions.evidence: She must close the café at 10 p.m.

questions.prompt: What did Lin forget last Thursday?
questions.explanation: 第四段最后说：Last Thursday, she forgot her keys. 所以选Her keys.。
questions.evidence: Last Thursday, she forgot her keys.

questions.prompt: On Friday, who must learn to make coffee?
questions.explanation: 第五段说：The new worker is Tom. He must learn to make coffee. 所以是Tom必须学做咖啡。
questions.evidence: He must learn to make coffee.

questions.prompt: On Saturday, Lin often visits her ______.
questions.explanation: 第六段说：She often visits her parents. 所以填parents。

questions.prompt: On Sunday, Lin must wash her ______.
questions.explanation: 第六段说：She must wash her uniform. 所以填uniform。

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，have to 和 must 都表示“必须、不得不”，但 have to 更强调客观需要，must 更强调主观义务。can 表示“能够、可以”。一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性的动作或状态；一般过去时表示过去发生的动作或状态。例如：She has to check the coffee machines.（一般现在时，表示她的日常工作）Last Thursday, she forgot her keys.（一般过去时，表示过去发生的事）。
grammar.example: She has to check the coffee machines.

options: She must to work on Monday.
questions.explanation: must 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，也不加 -s。所以选“She must work on Monday.”。
questions.evidence: She must open the café and turn on the lights.

options: He have to learn to make coffee.
He has to learn to make coffee.
He has to learns to make coffee.
answers: He has to learn to make coffee.
questions.explanation: 主语是 He（第三人称单数），have to 要变成 has to，后面动词用原形。所以选“He has to learn to make coffee.”。
questions.evidence: He must learn to make coffee.

options: Last Tuesday, a customer spills coffee.
Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee.
Last Tuesday, a customer spill coffee.
answers: Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee.
questions.explanation: Last Tuesday 表示过去时间，动词要用过去式 spilled。所以选“Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee.”。
questions.evidence: Last Tuesday, a customer spilled coffee.

options: She can goes home at 10:30 p.m.
She can go home at 10:30 p.m.
She can to go home at 10:30 p.m.
answers: She can go home at 10:30 p.m.
questions.explanation: can 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，也不加 -es。所以选“She can go home at 10:30 p.m.”。
questions.evidence: She can go home at 10:30 p.m.
